description: Application persistence settings. Paths resolve relative to this file; all settings are required.

settings.root: Filesystem store; never resolved relative to the process working directory.
settings.contentMaxCodePoints: Maximum Unicode code points in each nonempty Content payload.
settings.titleMaxCodePoints: Maximum Unicode code points in a nonblank Metadata title.
settings.summaryMaxCodePoints: Maximum Unicode code points in a nonblank Metadata summary.
settings.supportedMediaTypes: Allowed binary signature formats: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP. No fallback format.
